entities.name: Ellen Rosenblum
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ellen F. Rosenblum is an American lawyer and politician who served as the 17th Oregon Attorney General from June 2012 to December 2024. She is the first female state attorney general in Oregon's history, and previously was a judge on the Oregon Court of Appeals from 2005 to 2011.
